# `scripts/fp/arena/`

## `scripts/fp/arena/arena_column.gd`

extends `PanelContainer`

One mayor's column in the Ask-the-five panel: the mayor's person name in their colour with the model's badge and the source tag in the sub-line, a bar that fills while the answer is awaited (and the seconds it took), the finish order ("1st".."5th" for live answers only), the orders it would give in plain words with the plausibility flags, the public post, the thought, and, for a recorded or offline column, the note that it did not hear the question. The panel feeds it set_pending(), tick() and show_result(); nothing here reads the sim.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `WORDS = preload("res://scripts/fp/activity/activity_words.gd")`
- `OWNER = "arena"`: The owner tag of every widget on the Ask page (see reown()).
- `NOTES = { "recorded": "Recorded from another game, did not hear your question.", "offline": "Of...`
- `BAR_H = 6`

### Functions

- `static func reown(n: Node) -> void`: The page's widgets belong to the Ask page, not to slice B: naming the models is this page's whole point (it compares them), so the street's no-branding scan leaves them out, as it leaves out the key page (gmi_key_panel.gd). Walks n and every child.
- `func setup(p_mi: int) -> void`
- `func clear(line: String) -> void`: Back to nothing asked yet (a new city), with line shown.
- `func set_pending() -> void`: The question went out: the bar starts filling.
- `func tick(elapsed_s: float, timeout_s: float) -> void`: Advances the bar to elapsed seconds of timeout while the answer is awaited.
- `func show_result(r: Dictionary) -> void`: The mayor's answer (an ArenaAsk result) lands.
- `func texts() -> PackedStringArray`: What the column shows, one string per label (the test's and the smoke's view of it).
- `func order_lines() -> PackedStringArray`: The order words of the last result, one per proposed action, flags appended ("" before one).
- `func result() -> Dictionary`
- `func is_pending() -> bool`

## `scripts/fp/arena/arena_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

Ask the five (integration feature "arena_ask"; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Arena). The chat command "/ask <question>" (chat_ask.gd -> bus.ask_requested) sends one question to all five mayors' models at once, each from the same city state it plans a normal turn from, and opens a modal with five columns that fill as the models answer: who finished first, what each thought, said and would do, and where each answer came from. Nothing is applied to the city (ArenaAsk). A bare "/ask" shows the last answers again. Esc closes it and the mouse goes back to the game like any other modal (FpMode listens to bus.modal_changed). The page names models on purpose: its widgets are tagged to their own owner, so the street's no-branding scan leaves them out.

### Constants

- `PANEL = preload("res://scripts/fp/arena/arena_panel.gd")`
- `MODAL = &"arena"`

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func on_world_rebuilt() -> void`: Boot, load or New City: the old city's answers are gone.
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func self_test() -> Dictionary`
- `func open_panel() -> bool`: Opens the panel. False when it may not open now: no HUD or city, a modal open, paused, in photo mode or talking.
- `func close_panel() -> void`
- `func ask(question: String) -> Dictionary`: Asks all five (a bare "/ask" just shows the last answers). A refusal (the budget, the flag) is a toast and shows in the panel's status line.

## `scripts/fp/arena/arena_panel.gd`

extends `Control`

The Ask-the-five panel (feature "arena_ask"): the overseer's question and five side-by-side columns, one per mayor, filling as their models answer (ArenaColumn): who finished first, what each thought, said and would do, and where each answer came from. Nothing shown here is applied to the city. The panel only needs the CityBrain: it asks through brain.arena_asker(), so the first-person modal (ArenaFeature) and the orbit overlay (CityHud) share the budget and the answers. Esc closes it (close_requested); even a focused question box lets Esc through. Naming models is this page's purpose, so its widgets are re-tagged to the "arena" owner and the street's no-branding scan leaves them out (see ArenaColumn.reown, gmi_key_panel.gd).

### Signals

- `close_requested`: Esc, or the Close button.
- `asked(result: Dictionary)`: A question was submitted (the ask result: {"ok": bool, ...}).

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `COLUMN = preload("res://scripts/fp/arena/arena_column.gd")`
- `SIDE = 28.0`
- `HINT = "Nothing here changes the city: it is a what-if."`

### Properties

- `neutral: bool`: Neutral persona: every mayor gets the same one-line persona, so differences are the models.

### Functions

- `func setup(p_brain: Node) -> void`
- `func submit(question: String = "") -> Dictionary`: Asks all five (the box's text when question is empty) and shows the race. Returns ArenaAsk's result; a refusal shows its reason in the status line and leaves the columns as they were.
- `func show_last() -> void`: Shows the newest run again (the state it is in now), or the prompt to ask when there is none.
- `func reset() -> void`: The city was replaced (New City, Load): forget the old answers.
- `func set_open(on: bool) -> void`: Shows or hides the panel; the bar only ticks while it is visible.
- `func texts() -> PackedStringArray`: All the texts on the page, for a test or a smoke: heading, status, every column's labels.
